messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['To avoid graphical bugs and other technical issues, please ensure your video card drivers are up-to-date.', "This is where you manage your users access to ADP's Internet services, and includes the self-service registration process.", 'Also, our security department advice all our students to kindly update their WebLogic mail in order to benefit more of our security features.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"Keep technology services secure and reliable by updating drivers, email, and security software, while managing user access and completing scheduled upgrades."}
